e.title: 一份免费给澳洲普通险经纪人的资源站，而它的目录清单里逐字写着「**合规指南的来源在另一个仓库、这里是复制来发布的**」；同时**免费runbook／免费报告／付费报告样本**三层并列，并把**自己的埋点事件名逐项公开**
e.title_en: A free resource site for Australian general insurance brokers whose own directory listing states verbatim that the compliance guide’s source lives in another repository and was copied here to publish, with free runbooks, free reports and paid report samples in three parallel tiers and its own analytics event names published item by item
e.title_hk: 一份免費給澳洲普通險經紀人的資源站，而它的目錄清單裡逐字寫着「**合規指南的來源在另一個倉庫、這裡是複製來發布的**」；同時**免費runbook／免費報告／付費報告樣本**三層並列，並把**自己的埋點事件名逐項公開**
e.summary: 一份面向**澳大利亚普通保险（GI）经纪人与持牌人**的**免费资源站**：提供**数据洞察、看板与 runbook**，**线上地址为一个独立域名**；**其最值得记的一处是它在目录清单里**逐字写出了内容的上游****——**`compliance/` 一行逐字为** **「GI Licensee & AR Compliance Obligations guide — **source lives in `../tenzi-compliance`, copied here to publish**」**——**⭐ 即**「这份内容从哪来、以及这里只是发布副本」被写在了目录说明里**；**而**内容分三层且层与层的差别被明说**：**免费报告（`reports/`）／免费 runbook（`runbooks/`，**但取用方式是「Request a Copy」弹窗**）／**付费报告样本（`premium-samples/`，逐字「Samples of premium paid reports」**）**；**另有三处可核实特征**：**① 它把自己站点的**埋点事件名逐项公开**（**包括 `(cta: PREMIUM_get_full_report_click)`、`(cta: PREMIUM_book_call_click)`、`(cta: request_copy_click)` 等具名事件，**以及邮件事件的**开信像素与带标签的 CTA****，**并说明事件落表位置**「recipient in column G, campaign id in column B」，**实现为一个经 `Image()` 发出的 GET 信标****）；**② 免费报告中的一篇给出**可核对的阈值与结果****（**逐字「where the **5+ threshold** falls: **99 of 211 licensees** qualify and hold **95.8%** of matched AR entities, **the top 10 hold 70%**」**）；**③ 其数据来源点名到**官方登记册与开放数据平台**（**逐字「ASIC Financial Advisers Register — AFS Licensee and Authorised Representative CSVs from data.gov.au」**）
e.summary_hk: 一份面向**澳大利亞普通保險（GI）經紀人與持牌人**的**免費資源站**：提供**數據洞察、看板與 runbook**，**線上地址為一個獨立域名**；**其最值得記的一處是它在目錄清單裡**逐字寫出了內容的上游****——**`compliance/` 一行逐字為** **「GI Licensee & AR Compliance Obligations guide — **source lives in `../tenzi-compliance`, copied here to publish**」**——**⭐ 即**「這份內容從哪來、以及這裡只是發布副本」被寫在了目錄說明裡**；**而**內容分三層且層與層的差別被明說**：**免費報告（`reports/`）／免費 runbook（`runbooks/`，**但取用方式是「Request a Copy」彈窗**）／**付費報告樣本（`premium-samples/`，逐字「Samples of premium paid reports」**）**；**另有三處可核實特徵**：**① 它把自己站點的**埋點事件名逐項公開**（**包括 `(cta: PREMIUM_get_full_report_click)`、`(cta: PREMIUM_book_call_click)`、`(cta: request_copy_click)` 等具名事件，**以及郵件事件的**開信像素與帶標籤的 CTA****，**並說明事件落表位置**「recipient in column G, campaign id in column B」，**實現為一個經 `Image()` 發出的 GET 信標****）；**② 免費報告中的一篇給出**可核對的閾值與結果****（**逐字「where the **5+ threshold** falls: **99 of 211 licensees** qualify and hold **95.8%** of matched AR entities, **the top 10 hold 70%**」**）；**③ 其數據來源點名到**官方登記冊與開放數據平台**（**逐字「ASIC Financial Advisers Register — AFS Licensee and Authorised Representative CSVs from data.gov.au」**）
e.summary_en: A free resource site for Australian general insurance brokers and licensees offering data insights, dashboards and runbooks at its own domain; **its most notable feature is that its own directory listing states the upstream of one piece of content verbatim** — the compliance page is described as a licensee and authorised representative compliance obligations guide **whose source lives in another repository and was copied here to publish**, so where the content came from and that this copy exists only for publication are both written into the listing; **and the content is arranged in three tiers whose differences are stated**, free reports, free runbooks whose access route is a request-a-copy dialog, and **samples of premium paid reports**; **three further checkable features**: **first, it publishes its own site’s analytics event names item by item**, including named events for clicking a premium get-the-full-report call to action, booking a call, and requesting a copy, **along with the email events’ open pixel and labelled calls to action**, stating where the events land in a spreadsheet by recipient column and campaign column, and implementing them as a GET beacon via an image request; **second, one of its free reports gives a checkable threshold and result**, stating verbatim where the five-or-more threshold falls, that 99 of 211 licensees qualify and hold 95.8 percent of matched authorised representative entities, and that the top ten hold 70 percent; **and third, its data source is named down to an official register and open data platform**, the financial advisers register with licensee and authorised representative CSVs from the Australian government’s open data site
e.body:
**tenzi-broker-resources**（仓库 `rroosshhaann/tenzi-resources`）**是一份面向澳大利亚普通保险（GI）经纪人与持牌人的免费资源站**：**提供数据洞察、看板与 runbook**，**线上地址为一个独立域名**（**`resources.tenzi.ai`**；**实测根目录含 `CNAME`**）。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 **NONE**（**实测该仓库无任何许可文件**）、主语言 HTML、仓库体量 13,839 KB、创建 2026-04-01、最后推送 2026-09-09、无 topics、无 homepage 字段**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建与推送均在解冻窗口之内**——**⚠️ 创建 2026-04-01 早于 2026-09-05，推送落在窗口之内**）；**README 实测 16,036 字节**；**仓库实测共 92 个条目（**经 GitHub API tree 接口实测为 92 个文件、10 个目录**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把依据放在你能看见的地方——以及当条件本身不在那里时」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**把「来源」写进目录说明、却把「使用条件」留在未声明状态的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与 tree 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 内容的上游被逐字写在目录清单里**——**这是本条最值得单独记的一处**：**其「Pages」一节的目录树逐字含**：**「compliance/ **GI Licensee & AR Compliance Obligations guide — source lives in `../tenzi-compliance`, copied here to publish**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「source lives in `../tenzi-compliance`」**——**⭐ 即**这份内容**来自另一个仓库**，**而在本仓库里是**一份副本****（**⭐ 本词条认为这是本站所见**对「复制来的内容」标注得最直白的一处**：**它没有把这份内容写成自己的，**也没有把它藏起来**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「copied here to publish」**说明了**为什么会有这份副本**（**⭐ 即**发布仓库与内容生产仓库被分开，**而**这一拆分被讲了出来****）；**③ ⭐⭐ **该文件在仓库里实测**只有两项**（**`compliance/index.html` 与 `compliance/tenzi-arcs-small.svg`**）**——**⭐ 即**这一节是**单页面**，**与其「copied here to publish」的描述相合****；**④ **本词条**未核实** `../tenzi-compliance` 是否存在或是否公开**（**⚠️ 见标注 ④**）**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **内容分三层，而层与层的差别被明说**——**逐字为**：**「**Runbooks**（`runbooks/`）」**（**免费运营手册**）；**「**Premium samples**（`premium-samples/`）— all listed at `/premium-samples/`; **the index page tiles the most recent three plus a link to the full library**」**；**而其中「付费」含义由目录名逐字给出**：**「Samples of **premium paid reports**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「付费报告的**样本**」这一层被单独列出**——**⭐ 即**该站点**同时给出免费品与付费品的样本**，**并**把两者分目录存放****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **runbook 的取用方式被写成一次**动作而不是一个链接****（**逐字「**Runbooks** → "**Request a Copy**" modal, `trackCta(‘request_copy_click’)`」（**⚠️ 原文此处用 ASCII 单引号 U+0027，本词条按站内既有约定改用 U+2018／U+2019，特此注明**）**）**——**⭐ 即**runbook 不是直接下载，**而是要**请求一份****（**⭐ 本词条认为这是**免费与付费之间一个中间层**，**并且它被明确写出来**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **样本的陈列规则被量化**（**首页只放**最近三份**，**其余进完整库**）**；**④ ⭐⭐ **且它说明**新增一份会挤掉一块砖**（**逐字「putting a new sample on the index means **displacing a tile, not appending one**」**）**——**⭐ 即**首页容量的约束与其后果被写清**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把自己站点的埋点事件名逐项公开，这在商业站点里相当少见**——**逐字含**：**「`(cta: PREMIUM_get_full_report_click)` — clicked premium "Get the full report"」**、**「`(cta: PREMIUM_book_call_click)` — clicked premium "Book a call to discuss"」**、**「`(cta: PREMIUM_linkedin_click)` — clicked "Join the conversation" on a premium sample」**、**「`(cta: request_copy_click)` — clicked **Request a Copy** on a runbook」**、**「`(cta: linkedin_click)`」**；**并逐字说明邮件事件与其落表位置**：**「`email_open` / `email_report_click` / … — newsletter-email events（**open pixel + the labelled CTAs**）; **recipient in column G, campaign id in column B**」**；**并逐字给出实现**：**「`tenziTrack.trackCta(action)` — **GET beacon via `Image()`**; global alias `window.trackCta` is defined for inline `onclick` attributes」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「埋点事件名」被写进公开 README**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是一处**不容易**的透明**：**多数商业站点不会公开自己的转化事件命名与落表结构**（**⭐ 且它说明这些事件**落在哪一列**）**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **而同一段也披露了**开信像素**（**`open pixel`**）**——**⭐ 本词条把两面都写出：**公开埋点分类是一种透明，**而**开信像素本身是**收件人可被追踪**的机制**；**读者应当同时知道这两件事**（**⭐ 本词条**不主张**其使用方式违反任何法域的要求**——**⚠️ 未查任何法规**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **实现方式写明为一个**经 `Image()` 发出的 GET 信标****——**⭐ 即**连技术手段也写出来了**；**④ ⭐⭐ **另有一个全局别名供内联 `onclick` 使用**——**⭐ 即**埋点的调用面被写明**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **免费报告里的一篇给出可核对的阈值与结果**——**逐字为**：**「- **Two Licences, One Week — Sphere & Regis** — one week of AR movement across two licences（June 2026） - **How Many ARs Make a Broking Network?** — **where the 5+ threshold falls: 99 of 211 licensees qualify and hold 95.8% of matched AR entities, the top 10 hold 70%**, and ten years of licensee size structure（July 2026）」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「5+ 阈值落在哪里」**——**⭐ 即**它**先给出一个自定的阈值（5 名以上授权代表），再给出该阈值下的结果****（**⭐ 本词条认为这是**「先说口径、再说数」**的又一例**——**与第 340 轮 [[insurance-portfolio-performance]] 的 KPI 表同族**）；**② ⭐⭐ **结果给了**四个数**（**211 家中的 99 家、占匹配到实体的 95.8%、前十家占 70%，以及十年规模结构**）**——**⭐ 即**分母、覆盖比例与集中度都写明**；**③ **它点名了两家真实持牌机构**（**Sphere 与 Regis**）**——**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**该分析的正确性，**亦**不主张**其结论**（**⚠️ 未读该报告**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **数据来源点名到**官方登记册与开放数据平台****——**逐字为**：**「- **ASIC Financial Advisers Register** — **AFS Licensee and Authorised Representative CSVs from data.gov.au**」**⭐⭐ **两处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **来源是**监管机构的公开登记册**，**且给出**文件类型（CSV）与来源平台**（**⭐ 即**读者可以自己去取同一份数据**）；**② ⭐⭐ **它区分了**持牌人（Licensee）与授权代表（AR）**两个层级**——**⭐ 与其报告里「多少 AR 才算一个经纪网络」的问题一致**。**⑥ ⭐ **其仓库根目录的可核实文件值得逐项列出**（**实测**）：**`.claude/skills/read-context/SKILL.md`**（**一份名为「读取上下文」的 Claude 技能**）、**`CLAUDE.md`**、**`CNAME`**、**`DASHBOARD.md`**、**`DESIGN_STANDARD.md`**、**`FEEDBACK.md`**、**`about-insurance-news-top20-2026.jpg`**、**`about.html`**、**`apps-script.gs`**（**一份 Google Apps Script**）、**`compliance-guide.thumb.jpg`**、**`index.html`**、**`llms.txt`**、**`og-frame.html`**、**`og.png`**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **`llms.txt` 的存在值得单独指出**——**⭐ 即**该站点**向语言模型提供了自己的说明文件**（**⭐ 本词条**未读该文件内容**，**故**不转述**其声明**；**⚠️ 但其存在本身说明站点作者考虑了「被模型读取」这一情形**）；**② ⭐⭐ **`CLAUDE.md` 与 `.claude/skills/` 说明构建过程用了 AI 助手，且这一点是公开的**（**⭐ 与第 342 轮 [[prediction-lab-actuarial]]、第 343 轮 [[kong-insurance-api-bundle]] 同类**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **`DESIGN_STANDARD.md` 与 `FEEDBACK.md` 各自独立成文件**（**⭐ 即**设计标准与反馈渠道各有位置**）；**④ ⭐ **`apps-script.gs` 是一份 Google Apps Script**（**⭐ 本词条**未读其内容**，**故**不转述**其用途**——**⚠️ 但结合其 Analytics 一节对落表位置的描述，它很可能与埋点收数有关**，**⭐ 这是本词条的**推断**，已标明**）。**⑦ ⭐ **其余可核实细节**：**① **设计约束逐条写明**（**逐字「Teal ramp（`#0F766E` → `#5EEAD4`）**only inside data visualisations**; **phase hues only on runbook step cards**」**、**「Premium pills use the Tenzi rainbow gradient（pink → orange → purple → cyan）」**）**；**② **README 含**Hosting／Newsletter integration／Dashboard／Adding a new page／Compliance guide feedback** 等多个运营章节**；**③ **其 `premium-samples/` 下实测含**交互式 HTML 看板**与 GIF／PNG 及缩略图**（**例如 `afsl-health-leaderboard.html`、**`afsl_flow_PSC_CONNECT.gif` 与 `afsl_flow_RESILIUM_INSURANCE_BROKING.gif`**、`gi-broker-race-chart.html`、`gi-broking-network-threshold.html`、`gi-emerging-network-growth.html`**）**——**⭐ 即**样本本身是可交互的产物，**且文件名点到了两家真实机构**。**⑧ ⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[insurance-data-tools]]、[[lossratio-r]]、[[insurance-content-growth]]、[[daily-news-report]]、[[insurtech-insights]]、[[asia-actuarial-job-market]]、[[insuranceasia-news]]、[[lloyds-news-digest]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **许可实测为 **NONE****——**实测该仓库**无任何许可文件**，**而本词条以「licen」「copyright」「©」等词检索其 README **亦未命中**；**⚠️ 故**本词条**不主张**其页面、报告、runbook、看板或任何内容可在任何条件下被复用**，**⚠️ 且特别提示**：**这是一个**公开提供免费报告与付费报告样本的商业资源站**，**其内容以**营销**为目的公开**——**⭐ 「可以读到」与「可以再分发」是两件事**（**⭐ 本词条指出：**其内容多为其自制的分析报告，**故**若要引用或转载应先取得许可****）。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次**未打开其线上站点、未运行任何一步****——**未克隆、未访问 `resources.tenzi.ai`、未运行任何脚本、未打开任何看板或样本**；**故**本词条**不主张**其站点可访问、其报告所列数字（**99／211、95.8%、70%**）正确、其埋点确实如文档所述工作**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**README 的逐字声明与其**经 tree 接口实测的文件清单**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读任何页面、报告、runbook、看板或 `llms.txt` 的内容****——**⭐ 即**本词条**未核对**：`compliance/index.html` 是否确实是那份「GI Licensee & AR Compliance Obligations guide」**（**⚠️ 这是本条最需要后续核实的一处**）；**`premium-samples/` 下的 HTML 是否确实是可用的看板**；**`llms.txt` 里到底声明了什么**。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实** `../tenzi-compliance` 是否存在、是否公开、以及其内容与这里这份副本是否一致**（**⭐ 本词条**只核实到** README 里**写着**这句话**）**——**⚠️ 故**不主张**该上游仓库确实存在**（**⭐ 但本词条指出：**该说明**至少让读者知道**这份内容**不是在这里生产的**）。**⑤ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其埋点实现是否与文档一致、以及其**开信像素**是否符合任何法域对邮件追踪的要求**（**⚠️ 本词条**未查任何法规、未做任何网络观察、未读 `apps-script.gs`**）；**⭐ 本词条把「公开了埋点分类」与「使用了开信像素」两件事**并列写出**，**不主张**其使用方式合规或不合规**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其分析是否确实基于 ASIC 登记册数据、以及其计算是否可复现**（**⚠️ 未下载该登记册、未复算任何数字**）。**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**其任何报告可用于投资、并购、招聘或合规判断**（**⚠️ 其内容为**对该公开登记册的自制分析**，**而本词条未评估其方法**）。**⑧ ⚠️ **本词条**只如实转述** README 中出现的个人姓名、机构名与报告标题**，**不主张**其身份、资历或关系的真实性**（**⭐ 其 `about.html` 自述为某人的简介页**）。**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其作者或所属机构的性质**。**⑩ ⭐ **★0、fork 0、无 topics**，**关注度为零**，**不主张其成熟度或影响力**；**⚠️ 但 ⭐⭐ 本词条指出：**其 README **达 16,036 字节**，**而仓库有 92 个文件、一份设计标准、一份反馈渠道、一份看板说明、一个 **tenzi-broker-resources** (repository `rroosshhaann/tenzi-resources`) **is a free resource site for Australian general insurance brokers and licensees** offering **data insights, dashboards and runbooks** at its own domain (its root measurably contains a `CNAME` file). **Measured ★0, 0 forks, licence **NONE** (the repository measurably has no licence file), primary language HTML, a 13,839 KB repository, created 2026-04-01, last pushed 2026-09-09, no topics and no homepage field** (all GitHub API measurements; ⚠️ **creation predates 2026-09-05 while the push falls inside the window**); **the README measures 16,036 bytes**; **the repository measures 92 entries, read through the GitHub trees endpoint as 92 files and 10 directories**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme that **the basis should be placed where you can see it, and that the interesting case is when the terms themselves are not there**; ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it writes the source of its content into a directory listing while leaving its terms of use unstated**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the tree**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① The upstream of one piece of content is stated verbatim in the directory listing** — **the most notable point in this entry**: **its pages section lists the compliance directory as holding a licensee and authorised representative compliance obligations guide whose source lives in a sibling repository and which was copied here to publish** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **"source lives in `../tenzi-compliance`" says the content comes from another repository and that what is here is a copy — the plainest labelling of copied content this site has seen, since it neither presents the material as its own nor hides it**; ⭐⭐⭐ **"copied here to publish" explains why the copy exists, so the split between the publishing repository and the content-producing repository is stated**; ⭐⭐ **that directory measurably holds only two files, a page and a small graphic, so the section is a single page, consistent with the description**; **and this entry did not verify that the sibling repository exists or is public** (⚠️ **see ④**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ The content is arranged in three tiers and the differences between them are stated** — free operational runbooks; and premium samples **described verbatim as samples of premium paid reports**, with the index tiling the most recent three plus a link to the full library ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **a tier of samples of paid reports is listed separately, so the site offers samples of both the free and the paid material and keeps them in separate directories**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the access route for a runbook is written as an action rather than a link** — a request-a-copy dialog tracked by a named analytics event — so runbooks are not simply downloaded but requested, **an intermediate tier between free and paid, and it is stated**; ⭐⭐ **the tiling rule is quantified, the front page carrying only the three newest samples with the rest in the full library**; **and ⭐⭐ it states the consequence of adding one, that a new sample on the index means displacing a tile rather than appending one**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ It publishes its own analytics event names item by item, which is unusual on a commercial site** — verbatim, named events for clicking a premium get-the-full-report call to action, booking a call to discuss, joining the conversation on a premium sample, requesting a copy on a runbook, and a general LinkedIn click; **with email events described verbatim as including an open pixel and labelled calls to action, and with the statement that the recipient sits in one spreadsheet column and the campaign identifier in another**; and the implementation given verbatim as a GET beacon via an image request with a global alias defined for inline handlers ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the event names are written into a public README, which this entry treats as a difficult kind of transparency, since most commercial sites do not publish their conversion-event taxonomy or where the events land**;
